// mkfixture writes an ML-DSA-44 key, and data signed with it, using
// github.com/johanix/dnssec-algorithms/mldsa44 at 4d74f08 -- the package
// tdns used before ML-DSA-44 was built in.
package main

import (
	"crypto"
	"encoding/pem"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"github.com/johanix/dnssec-algorithms/mldsa44"
	dnsalgpkcs8 "github.com/johanix/dnssec-algorithms/pkcs8"
	"github.com/miekg/dns"
)

func main() {
	out := os.Args[1]
	must(dns.RegisterAlgorithm(18, mldsa44.New()))
	const owner = "mldsa44.example."
	key := &dns.DNSKEY{
		Hdr:       dns.RR_Header{Name: owner, Rrtype: dns.TypeDNSKEY, Class: dns.ClassINET, Ttl: 3600},
		Flags:     257,
		Protocol:  3,
		Algorithm: 18,
	}
	priv, err := key.Generate(0)
	must(err)
	der, err := dnsalgpkcs8.Marshal(priv)
	must(err)
	txt := &dns.TXT{
		Hdr: dns.RR_Header{Name: owner, Rrtype: dns.TypeTXT, Class: dns.ClassINET, Ttl: 3600},
		Txt: []string{"signed before ML-DSA-44 moved into tdns"},
	}
	sig := &dns.RRSIG{
		Hdr:        dns.RR_Header{Name: owner, Rrtype: dns.TypeRRSIG, Class: dns.ClassINET, Ttl: 3600},
		Algorithm:  18,
		KeyTag:     key.KeyTag(),
		SignerName: owner,
		Inception:  1790208000, // 2026-09-24
		Expiration: 2105827200, // 2036-09-24
	}
	must(sig.Sign(priv.(crypto.Signer), []dns.RR{txt}))
	must(sig.Verify(key, []dns.RR{txt}))

	write(out, "private.pem", string(pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "PRIVATE KEY", Bytes: der})))
	write(out, "private.bind", key.PrivateKeyString(priv))
	write(out, "dnskey.txt", key.String()+"\n")
	write(out, "signed.txt", txt.String()+"\n"+sig.String()+"\n")
	fmt.Printf("keytag %d\n", key.KeyTag())
}

func write(dir, name, s string) { must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, name), []byte(s), 0o644)) }

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
